first.rationale: The immediate competitive threat is concentrated in price-sensitive SMBs, and targeted promotional pricing has prior evidence of acquisition and revenue lift in that segment. A small guarded test limits discounting and long-term value risk while validating whether the prior result remains applicable under the current competitor-pricing shock. Onboarding deterioration is also material, so its prior evidence should be verified as the main alternative before commitment.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment simplifying onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has verified evidence of higher completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention—stronger support for sustainable qualified revenue than discounting. Preserve essential qualification and routing fields so reduced friction does not degrade lead quality. Do not use promotional pricing: its source record showed a 12% 30-day retention decline despite short-term revenue lift.
